transformer_phase_shift_status: MathWorks Delta 1 clock convention states that the delta winding lags the connected wye voltage by 30 degrees. With winding 1 on HV buses 4/7/9 and winding 2 on LV buses 1/2/3, the HV-side tap angle for V_HV/V_LV is +30 degrees. This sign also gives a 0.16065 MVA maximum nodal mismatch against the stored operating-point snapshot; the opposite sign gives 1859.86 MVA.

per_unit_conversion.transformer_series: sum winding pu impedances, then multiply by Sbase/Srated and voltage-base squared ratio
per_unit_conversion.generator_current_injection: Ipu_system = Ipu_machine * Srated/Sbase when voltage bases match; differential equations remain on machine base
